verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude builds a first version from a described visual, generates many design directions, and lets users refine by conversation, inline comments, direct edits, and sliders. Hands-on reports confirm it produces real output, such as a shippable landing page. Some users found results underwhelming or boring, but that is about output quality, not whether the capability exists. missing for 10: consistently strong output quality in hands-on reports, detailed documentation of full multi-screen mockup generation.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Describe a visual and Claude builds a first version, on brand.
you refine through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders (made by Claude) until it's right
Generate a dozen directions in minutes, then narrow down in your primary tool.
Used Claude Design to build the landing page for my side project over the weekend. Got something shippable in a few hours.
